verification_note: Compiled from the Income Tax / VAT (Amendment) Acts 2026 as reported by professional-firm and press summaries in June-July 2026. Not yet reconciled line-by-line against the gazetted Acts or a URA-published rate card. Secondary sources conflict on the second PAYE band (10% vs 20%) and on the VAT registration threshold (UGX 250m at Bill stage vs UGX 300m as passed); both are recorded at the figure the enacted-Act summaries and the published worked examples support. Confirm figures with URA before relying on them.

legal_basis.vat_registration_threshold_annual: VAT (Amendment) Act 2026 - registration threshold raised to UGX 300,000,000
legal_basis.paye_bands_resident: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026, Third Schedule Part I
legal_basis.paye_bands_non_resident: Income Tax Act (Cap 340), Third Schedule Part II
legal_basis.nssf_employee_contribution: National Social Security Fund Act (Cap 230), s.11 - standard employee contribution. A social-security contribution, not a URA tax; it is not deductible before PAYE.
legal_basis.corporation_tax: Income Tax Act (Cap 340), s.6 and Third Schedule Part IV
legal_basis.capital_gains_corporate: Income Tax Act (Cap 340), s.18 - gains included in gross income
legal_basis.rental_tax_individual: Income Tax Act (Cap 340), s.5 as amended
legal_basis.rental_tax_company: Income Tax Act (Cap 340), s.22(1)(c) expense cap
legal_basis.withholding_royalty: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026 - royalty rate raised to 15%, definition extended to software
legal_basis.withholding_public_entertainer: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026 - withholding on payments to public entertainers
legal_basis.withholding_betting_winnings: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026 - withholding on betting/gaming winnings reintroduced
legal_basis.withholding_foreign_interest: Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2026 - interest paid by resident companies to non-resident lenders
legal_basis.customs_duty_common: EAC Common External Tariff - finished goods band
legal_basis.environmental_levy_used_clothing: Excise/environmental levy 2026 - worn clothing imports, share of CIF value

notes.paye_bands_resident: The monthly tax-free threshold rises from UGX 235,000 to UGX 335,000 and a 25% band is introduced between UGX 410,000 and UGX 485,000. The 20% band on UGX 335,000-410,000 is unchanged from FY2025-26; the 30% band and the additional 10% charge above UGX 10,000,000 per month are retained, and the top band is expressed here as a single 40% marginal rate. Secondary summaries disagreed on the second band, some reporting 10%. It is recorded as 20% because both statutory-style restatements of the Third Schedule corroborate it: the cumulative-tax figure quoted for the next band, 'UGX 180,000 plus 25% of the excess', is exactly 20% x (4,920,000 - 4,020,000) annual, and the published worked example of UGX 1,900,000 gross reproduces the quoted PAYE of UGX 458,250 only at 20% (at 10% it gives 450,750).
notes.rental_tax_individual: Individuals may elect to file monthly provisional rental returns from FY2026-27. The rate and annual threshold are unchanged.
notes.vat_registration_threshold_annual: Businesses below UGX 300,000,000 annual turnover are no longer required to register, though voluntary registration remains available.
notes.customs_duty_common: Indicative EAC CET band for finished consumer goods. The binding rate is the tariff line for the specific HS code.
